issue_context.title: Ability to mark a draft PR ready for review
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

When I create a draft PR and then push more commits such that it's ready for review, there's no way I can switch it from a draft to a ready for review PR without going to the browser.

### Proposed solution

I don't have any strong feelings about implementation, but it seems related to updating labels, assignees, reviewers, etc. after a PR has been created so it might be in something like `pr edit`, or might be its own action, like `pr ready`. I'll defer to @ampinsk for thoughts on that, knowing that we'll need to account for a variety of similar scenarios to this.
comments: We discussed that this would also likely include converting to draft status. @ampinsk I think you had ideas for designs you wanted to share here, unless you already shared those with @probablycorey.

> We're going to punt on converting back to draft for now since that's a considerably less frequent action.

I've been looking at APIs for this. I was convinced that there is a REST API for converting draft status back and forth, but [that does not work](https://github.com/github/hub/issues/1523#issuecomment-633694846). There is a GraphQL mutation to mark a PR ready-for-review, which we are already making use of, but there does not seem to exist a mutation for doing the opposite. So if we ever want to support converting a PR back to draft, we have to keep in mind that we should first get an API exposed for this from the platform end.

review_comments: I couldn't find this struct in the githubv4 types, so I made my own. I'm not sure if this is the way to go.
This looks good! It's most likely a newer API that landed only after the github4 library last synced its schema.
